lines.text: If you're in a rush right now, this station isn't for you. But stay. Just this once. See what happens.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Nothing. Isn't it nice.

lines.text: Whatever you didn't finish today, you can carry it on your back tomorrow. That's what we do.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne

lines.text: I've moved. You can't tell. But I have.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne

clips.title: Greg Comes Home, Part Five: Half a Hat

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We have a guest on the leaf.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: He came through very fast this morning. Again. And this time, I called out. I said, slow down.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: And he did.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Hello. Sorry. I'm in a bit of a hurry. I'm going home.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We'll fix that.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Last time you went past, you dropped something. We kept it for you. Under the mushroom.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Half a hat.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Oh. That's the shadow of half my hat. I've been wondering where it went.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's been very good. It didn't move at all.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Why is everyone being so kind?

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Because you're going home.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: And the way home should be slow. So you notice it.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: How slow?

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Stay for one song. Just one. Sit on the leaf.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Isn't it nice.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: It is, actually.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: When it gets dark, the fireflies will light you to the edge of the garden. They don't offer that to just anyone.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Here's your song, Greg. Take your time.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's Halloween week.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We've carved a pumpkin.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Well. We've started.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We'll have a face by Christmas.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail Jams.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Boo.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Sorry. That took a while to get here.
